description: Get a description for the specified queue.

operations.description: Returns a description for the specified queue.

params.description: Name of the Resource group within the Azure subscription.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: Subscription credentials that uniquely identify a Microsoft Azure subscription. The subscription ID forms part of the URI for every service call.
params.name: subscriptionId

props.description: Fully qualified resource ID for the resource. Ex - /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}
props.name: id

props.description: The geo-location where the resource lives
props.name: location

props.description: The name of the resource
props.name: name

props.description: Queue Properties
props.name: properties

props.description: Last time a message was sent, or the last time there was a receive request to this queue.
props.name: accessedAt

props.description: ISO 8061 timeSpan idle interval after which the queue is automatically deleted. The minimum duration is 5 minutes.
props.name: autoDeleteOnIdle

props.description: Message Count Details.
props.name: countDetails

props.description: Number of active messages in the queue, topic, or subscription.
props.name: activeMessageCount

props.description: Number of messages that are dead lettered.
props.name: deadLetterMessageCount

props.description: Number of scheduled messages.
props.name: scheduledMessageCount

props.description: Number of messages transferred into dead letters.
props.name: transferDeadLetterMessageCount

props.description: Number of messages transferred to another queue, topic, or subscription.
props.name: transferMessageCount

props.description: The exact time the message was created.
props.name: createdAt

props.description: A value that indicates whether this queue has dead letter support when a message expires.
props.name: deadLetteringOnMessageExpiration

props.description: ISO 8601 default message timespan to live value. This is the duration after which the message expires, starting from when the message is sent to Service Bus. This is the default value used when TimeToLive is not set on a message itself.
props.name: defaultMessageTimeToLive

props.description: ISO 8601 timeSpan structure that defines the duration of the duplicate detection history. The default value is 10 minutes.
props.name: duplicateDetectionHistoryTimeWindow

props.description: Value that indicates whether server-side batched operations are enabled.
props.name: enableBatchedOperations

props.description: A value that indicates whether Express Entities are enabled. An express queue holds a message in memory temporarily before writing it to persistent storage.
props.name: enableExpress

props.description: A value that indicates whether the queue is to be partitioned across multiple message brokers.
props.name: enablePartitioning

props.description: Queue/Topic name to forward the Dead Letter message
props.name: forwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo

props.description: Queue/Topic name to forward the messages
props.name: forwardTo

props.description: ISO 8601 timespan duration of a peek-lock; that is, the amount of time that the message is locked for other receivers. The maximum value for LockDuration is 5 minutes; the default value is 1 minute.
props.name: lockDuration

props.description: The maximum delivery count. A message is automatically deadlettered after this number of deliveries. default value is 10.
props.name: maxDeliveryCount

props.description: Maximum size (in KB) of the message payload that can be accepted by the queue. This property is only used in Premium today and default is 1024.
props.name: maxMessageSizeInKilobytes

props.description: The maximum size of the queue in megabytes, which is the size of memory allocated for the queue. Default is 1024.
props.name: maxSizeInMegabytes

props.description: The number of messages in the queue.
props.name: messageCount

props.description: A value indicating if this queue requires duplicate detection.
props.name: requiresDuplicateDetection

props.description: A value that indicates whether the queue supports the concept of sessions.
props.name: requiresSession

props.description: The size of the queue, in bytes.
props.name: sizeInBytes

props.description: Enumerates the possible values for the status of a messaging entity.
props.name: status

props.description: The exact time the message was updated.
props.name: updatedAt

props.description: The system meta data relating to this resource.
props.name: systemData

props.description: The timestamp of resource creation (UTC).
props.name: createdAt

props.description: The identity that created the resource.
props.name: createdBy

props.description: The type of identity that created the resource.
props.name: createdByType

props.description: The type of identity that last modified the resource.
props.name: lastModifiedAt

props.description: The identity that last modified the resource.
props.name: lastModifiedBy

props.description: The type of identity that last modified the resource.
props.name: lastModifiedByType

props.description: The type of the resource. E.g. "Microsoft.EventHub/Namespaces" or "Microsoft.EventHub/Namespaces/EventHubs"
props.name: type

responses.description: ServiceBus error response describing why the operation failed.
